lens: Geometry and proportion first. Scripts are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/34470b21-5ad4-5cec-977a-20c7657c0e01/scratchpad/raterB39/. m.py, pans.py and far.py are the w38 scripts re-pointed to r38 vs r39. belts.py counts light-grey and teal pixels in four 100 x 65 windows at the pillow foot (q15 y 460-525) and diffs the studio units. Crops in the same folder: z_low.png (y_47300 | r38 | r39, q15 low band), t_q16/q17 (photo | r38 | r39), c_e10_under.png (e10 + e7, s38 | s39), c_e1_front.png (e1 + e4b), c_e11_panedge.png (e11 + e4) and pouch39.png (y_47302 crop over e10 s39). The r38 to r39 diff changes 17.3 % of q15, 12.1 % of q16 and 5.8 % of q17. There were no lighting commits: the near pans are bit-identical (L69.0 / 67.9 / 68.1 / 64.4 in both rounds), so every change measured here is an econ change. Studio: e11 changes 42.7 %, e4b 35.2 %, e7 35.1 %, e10 21.9 %, e1 21.1 % and e4 13.0 %; the others are under 8 %.

priorIssues.id: w38b-1 (low) buckle blocks on every pan
priorIssues.note: Light-grey px in the four pillow-foot windows (belts.py): r39 1012 vs r38 1591, photo 882. The cover is now navy-grey and tucked under the pillow edge, and the silver tongue is about the size of the small buckle that y_47300 also shows under each pillow. Teal px stay at 0. What remains is a short navy strap V on either side of the tongue, which y_47300 does not show (see w39b-4).

priorIssues.id: w38b-2 (low) pouch edge-on from the high front views
priorIssues.note: e7 and e1 now show the fan face: a 120 x 60 px grey half-disc in e7 where r38 had a 2-3 px sliver with a floating strap. e10 and e11 show it too. Against y_47302 (pouch39.png) the read is right: a lighter smoky fan under the pan front with a red strap. There are three differences. (a) It is opaque mid-grey (shell #767983 over core #5e6068), while the photo's shell is translucent, showing a dark vest with an orange fleck through it. (b) The strap is 8 cm long and stops at the rim. In the photo it hangs about a third of its length below the rim, with the blue tag at the top. (c) From e11 it reads as a flat half-disc, where the photo's fan reads as a wider, flatter lens.

Pillow L46.9 / 48.8 / 48.3 / 48.1 (r38 37.9-39.8) vs photo 61.7 / 50.5 / 50.4 / 46.6, at B/R 2.06-2.07 vs 1.99-2.03. The pillow/pan ratio is 0.71 vs 0.66 (r38 0.58). The shape is still a plain rounded plaque (e4b). The photo pillows show pulled-out corners and pinched mid-edges, most clearly on seat 3.

farA L90.8 B/R 1.71 p90/p10 2.57, L>150 4.8 % (r38 92.8 / 2.54 / 5.0 %; photo 97.1 / 3.72 / 13.6 %). farB 83.2 / 2.70 vs 85.9 / 3.20. Level and hue still match. The dark row gaps and the light headrest tops are still missing.

priorIssues.id: w38b-5 (low) cover less blue; tray lip
priorIssues.note: q15 cover box L58.2 B/R 1.62 (photo 50.8 / 1.83). The black lip under the pan front is unchanged in e11.

priorIssues.id: w38b-6 (low) near pans ~10 L dark from lighting
priorIssues.note: Pans are bit-identical to r38: L64-69 vs photo 74-87. No lighting commit this round.

q15 fleck backs (seats 2 and 4): L49.9 / 50.6 (r38 58.2 / 58.8) vs photo 57.9 / 52.4. The mean error went from +3.4 to -4.9 L, but contrast p90/p10 is now 2.99 / 2.92 vs 3.00 / 2.95 (r38 2.73 / 2.64). B/R is 2.12 vs 2.25-2.30. In e4 and e1 the fleck back now reads a shade deeper than the tick, as in y_47300. Rater A's L90-vs-70 view should confirm the gain there.

details.refs: Up 0.1. Contrast now matches in q15 (p90/p10 2.92-2.99 vs 2.95-3.00). L is 50 vs 52-58, 5 L dark, and B/R is 2.12 vs 2.25-2.30.
Up 0.1. L48 vs 47-62 and B/R 2.06 vs 2.0, so level and hue now match. The shape is still a plaque.
Up 0.1. Light-grey px 1012 vs photo 882 (r38 1591), so the hardware now reads as y_47300's small buckle. A short navy strap V still shows either side of it.
Geometry unchanged. The tray lip remains.
Unchanged (e5 7.6 %, from the fleck back around it).
Up 0.1. The pouch face now shows from e7, e1, e10 and e11, as the fan does in y_47302, so the w38 regression is gone. It is still opaque, and the strap stops at the rim instead of hanging below it.
Unchanged. Level and hue match, but contrast is 2.57 vs 3.72.

issues.title: Far rows: right colour, too little contrast (carried w38b-4)
issues.evidence: farA p90/p10 2.57 vs 3.72, L>150 4.8 % vs 13.6 %. farB 2.70 vs 3.20. This is the lowest-scoring visible detail after the tray.
issues.fix: In econUnitFar add a 1 cm dark '#1c2236' strip under each headrest cover and across the back top behind it (the row gap), and lift the far headrest-top tint toward '#5a6898' so the tops catch light. Leave the LOD switch alone.

issues.title: Hard black tray lip under the pan front; cover less blue (carried w38b-5)
issues.evidence: e11 shows an unchanged black lip along every pan front. Cover B/R 1.62 vs 1.83.
issues.fix: Tray gRBox depth 0.41 -> 0.39, set 2 cm aft, r 0.8. SEATMAT.yCover '#222842' -> '#232a4a' (shared, one line).

issues.title: Life-vest pouch opaque; strap ends at the rim
issues.evidence: pouch39.png: y_47302 shows a translucent smoky shell with a dark vest and an orange fleck inside, and a red strap whose lower third hangs below the rim with the blue tag at the top. The render has an opaque mid-grey half-disc with an 8 cm strap that ends at the rim.
issues.fix: Strap gBox height 0.08 -> 0.12 and centre 2 cm lower (y 0.207 -> 0.19, z -0.390 -> -0.40), so about 4 cm hangs past the rim. Core '#5e6068' -> '#45474f' with a 1 x 3 cm '#c87a2a' fleck on it, and shell r 0.12 -> 0.3 so it reads as smoky plastic over a dark vest, not a flat plate.

issues.title: Short navy strap V either side of the buckle under every q15 pillow
issues.evidence: z_low.png: two 10 cm straps at +/-30 deg show below each pillow. y_47300 shows only the small silver buckle.
issues.fix: Strap gBox length 0.10 -> 0.06 and yaw 30 -> 15 deg, so the strap lies under the pillow foot. Or y 0.476 -> 0.468 to sink it into the crease.

issues.title: Pillow shape still a plain plaque (carried w38b-3 shape)
issues.evidence: e4b and z_low: straight edges and even rounding. y_47300 pillows have pulled-out corners and pinched mid-edges.
issues.fix: Pillow loft: corners out 1.5 cm, mid-edges pinched 1 cm, centre 1 cm thicker.

issues.title: Near pans about 10 L dark (carried w38b-6; not scored for econ)
issues.evidence: Pans are bit-identical to r38: L64-69 vs photo 74-87.
issues.fix: Lighting owner: check the low-height fill or AO at the q15 camera. Econ should not compensate.
